entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game inventory icon for ItsAlmostNight. Create ONE chunky closed magical hardcover tome, tilted slightly in a three-quarter isometric view with its broad front cover facing the viewer; visible thick ivory page block on lower/right side and a substantial spine on the left. Match chunky cartoon defense-building icons: bold near-black outer and inner contour, about 5-6 pixels at final 256px size, broad clean low-poly cel-shaded color planes, soft bevelled edges, 2-3 tones per material, light from upper left, orange/gold metal corners and clasp, restrained cream highlights. The book is the only object. Large simple raised emblem centered on cover, readable at 40px. Consistent book silhouette across the series; cover facing forward, spine at left, pages at lower right, subtle diagonal tilt. Center the whole book, fill about 83% of square canvas with transparent padding on every side. Actual transparent alpha background. No scenery, ground, cast shadow outside object, glow, sparkles, text, lettering, numbers, banners, badge or icon tile/frame. No tiny decorations, ornate filigree, realistic textures or brush strokes. Output square PNG. Reference image is the base tome for this cohesive series. Preserve its exact book silhouette, camera angle, gold hardware, ivory page block, bold contour and shading style. Change only the cover hue and the central embossed emblem. Remove its castle-shield emblem completely. New variant subject: slate blue cover with one chunky golden gauntlet fist pointing right with two short ivory impact strokes, knockback.
